Fleet.title: Drive a Cool Car with Vonco Partners
Fleet.description: We are looking for drivers who love the road as much as we do. We have about 100 cars for every taste: from reliable workhorses like the **Skoda Fabia** to comfortable **Toyota Camry**, **Lexus**, and even **Tesla**. Most cars are modern hybrids, so you spend less on fuel and earn more.
Fleet.incomeNote: With us, you can take home up to **55% of the revenue**. Everything is transparent and fair.
Fleet.flexibility: Rent a car alone or share with a partner to make it cheaper. We will adjust the schedule to suit you — perfect for students or as a side job.

cards.rentDesc: Take a car for work and personal use. No hidden mileage limits.
cards.shiftDesc: Work when it's convenient: day, night, or only on weekends. You are your own boss.
cards.doubleDesc: You can share a car with a friend and work in shifts. It's more profitable for both.

footerBox.title: Want to Join Our Team?
footerBox.text: We provide cars in Krakow and Zakopane. If you are from another city — no problem, we will help you become a driver with your own car and connect you to profitable Vonco settlements.

FleetInfo.title: Work as a Driver with Vonco Partners
FleetInfo.description1: We collaborate with taxi service drivers and provide modern cars for work and daily use.
FleetInfo.description2: Our fleet includes about 100 cars of various classes: Toyota Prius (different models), Corolla, Camry, Lexus, Tesla, Skoda Fabia, and Superb.

car.title: Car for Work
car.desc: Car at your disposal — for work and personal trips, no deposit and no mileage limits.
car.fullDetails: You receive a fully prepared car with a taxi license. We cover all maintenance costs, oil changes, and repairs. The car stays with you 24/7 — you can use it for both work and your own needs.

data.conditions: No deposit, no mileage limits, car with taxi license
data.result: Start work quickly and use the car for both work and personal trips

benefits.item1: Ready-to-work vehicle with taxi license and full technical readiness
benefits.item2: No deposit and no mileage limits for daily use
benefits.item3: Maintenance, oil changes, and repairs are covered by the fleet

schedule.title: Flexible Schedule
schedule.desc: Work when it's convenient: day, night, or only on weekends. You are your own boss.
schedule.fullDetails: We have no mandatory shifts or quotas. You choose when to go online. This allows you to combine taxi work with studies, a primary job, or family matters. Your income depends solely on your activity.

data.result: You control your time and income

benefits.item1: Choose your own working hours and days
benefits.item2: No mandatory shifts or fixed minimum quotas
benefits.item3: Easy to combine with study, family, or another job

shared.title: Car Lease-to-Own
shared.desc: Opportunity to buy out the car via installments and continue working with your own vehicle.
shared.fullDetails: A program for those who want to become car owners. You rent a car with the right to buy it out. Part of the rental payment goes toward the car's value. Transparent terms with no hidden fees.

data.bestFor: Drivers planning to move to their own car
data.conditions: Part of payments can go toward buyout under clear terms
data.result: Step-by-step transition from renting to ownership

benefits.item1: Clear lease-to-own model with transparent terms
benefits.item2: Part of payments can be counted toward buyout
benefits.item3: Step-by-step move from renting to your own car

taximeter.fullDetails: We provide a modern electronic taximeter integrated into your smartphone. This allows you to legally accept cash and card payments, automatically transmit data to the tax office, and work without the risk of fines.

data.result: Legal settlements and reduced risk of penalties

benefits.item1: Official digital taximeter integrated with smartphone
benefits.item2: Supports legal cash and card settlements
benefits.item3: Automatic fiscal flow helps reduce compliance risks

CarFleet.title: Our Fleet:
CarFleet.description: If you don't have your own car — we can help. Vonco Partners has a fleet of well-maintained, modern cars that regularly undergo technical inspections and provide comfortable and safe work. We have various models — from economical Skoda Fabia to comfortable Toyota Camry, Lexus, and even Tesla. Most cars are hybrids, allowing you to spend less on fuel and earn more. You can rent a car for work and personal trips without a deposit and mileage limits. For drivers focused on long-term cooperation, individual discussion of car buyout conditions within the cooperation with Vonco Partners is possible.
